armyListText:
The Grumpy Golden Janitorial Staff of The Galaxy's Most Extravagant Care Home!!!

These fine ladies and gentlemen have spent a millenia looking after a sad withered, so called god. Changing his diapers, wiping up his drool, you get the idea. 

They are looking for something new and exciting. Something that will make them feel alive again. Something that isnt mindlessly standing still for decades on end while keeping the watch. After all, the walls the Palace do get a bit stale to look at after a while.....
